messages:
asha: FYI canary in eu-west started seeing a TLS handshake spike right after the RBAC prune at 11:02 UTC. saw client hello then immediate aborts.

maria: that's the PR I merged at 11:00 to remove some broad platform bindings. Which service is failing?

dmitri: keystore-rotator can't GET /v1/certs — returns 403. Shortly after we see KMS AccessDenied when rotator tries local unwrap. Logs show `AccessDeniedException` with KMS key arn.

sre-oncall: impact: edge proxies dropped ~1.5% of handshakes for canary, some session-resume attempts forwarded wrong SNI. Quick mitigation: re-add keystore-reader to platform-service-accounts for canary and restart rotator.

maria: rolling that now to canary only. approving emergency bind.

compliance-bot: audit request created: collect keystore-store and rotator logs 11:00-11:15 UTC, include IAM state snapshot pre-merge.

dmitri: after restart rotator GETs succeeded and TLS failures fell to baseline in ~3 min. Root cause looks like RBAC removal + rotator fallback to direct KMS unwrap (which used different role without decrypt perms).

asha: followups: 1) infra CI pre-merge check to prevent removing keystore-reader from critical groups (owner: maria) 2) add metric for rotator fallback_attempt and alert on >1 fallback/min (owner: dmitri) 3) add emergency proxy playbook step to disable session-ticket resume in canary (owner: sre).

maria: will open guard PR and post-merge check job.

dmitri: will change rotator to not silently fallback to KMS unwrap; require ENABLE_DIRECT_KMS_UNWRAP env var to be true to allow that path and log structured fallback events.

sre-oncall: noted. marking this Sev3; will escalate if it reappears in other regions.
